name: JSON Grid
description: Explore and edit JSON as nested grids, DevTools-style trees and source. Copy JSONPath, search, filter and format locally.
releaseNotes: Cancel inline key/value drafts on confirmed clicks or focus transfers elsewhere inside the plugin. Preserve the editor and draft when the window loses focus, then resume on return. Enter commits; Escape cancels. No host integration required.

zh-CN.name: JSON Grid
zh-CN.description: 将 JSON 转为可编辑嵌套网格与 DevTools 风格树形，支持路径复制、搜索筛选、格式化和撤销；数据在本地处理。
